Lunai Bioworks Harnesses AI and Zebrafish Data to Advance Early Detection of Neurotoxic Compounds
body_text: NEW YORK, NY / ACCESS Newswire / October 30, 2025 / In the face of growing global concern over the potential use of chemical weapons such as the nerve agent Sarin, Lunai Bioworks Inc. (NASDAQ:LNAI) today announced promising early results from its AI-based platform designed to identify compounds that interact with acetylcholinesterase (AChE), the same molecular target affected by nerve agents. "This research brings us closer to a future where proactive, AI-powered screening can detect and evaluate neurotoxic compounds before they become threats," said David Weinstein , CEO of Lunai Bioworks. "Our vision is to use in vivo systems like zebrafish, combined with predictive AI, to rapidly identify neurotoxic threats and screen for countermeasures, and leverage our AI models to help safeguard against the creation of new neurotoxins." Using a combination of chemical feature analysis and machine learning classifiers , Lunai's platform demonstrated an ability to differentiate active AChE inhibitors from inactive compounds with high accuracy (0.94 AUROC; Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve). The work builds on models trained using the company's in-house neuroactive compound screening data, as well as public sources, and applies predictive modeling to identify chemical signatures associated with AChE inhibition. Compounds with previously unidentified, potential neurotoxic activity have been identified for follow-up and validation. Lunai's work represents a responsible application of AI , focused on defense and public health , not harm. The announcement comes amid increasing concern about the potential misuse of generative AI technologies, underscored by a recent NBC News investigation showing how AI chatbots could be manipulated to share instructions for creating dangerous substances, including nerve agents. In future phases, the company plans to integrate its behavioral zebrafish profiling platform to observe real-time physiological effects of predicted inhibitors, helping prioritize candidate compounds for further development as potential countermeasures . Zebrafish are an FDA-recognized model for toxicology and drug discovery, offering a unique balance of genetic relevance to humans and scalability unmatched by rodent models. Lunai's platform leverages these advantages by coupling high-throughput behavioral assays in zebrafish with machine learning models trained to recognize neurotoxic phenotypes. This approach enables rapid, low-cost screening of both suspected threat agents and potential countermeasure compounds, often identifying hits within days rather than months , a critical advantage in time-sensitive defense and public health scenarios. To support collaboration, Lunai has embedded its predictive model into a customized dashboard, allowing partners to explore their chemical structures and determine if they have potential neurotoxicity. About Lunai Lunai Bioworks Inc. is an AI-powered drug discovery and biodefense company pioneering safe and responsible generative biology. With proprietary neurotoxicity datasets, advanced machine learning, and a focus on dual-use risk management, Lunai is redefining how artificial intelligence can accelerate therapeutic innovation while safeguarding society from emerging threats. title: Top 5 TikTok Health Trends Worth Trying for Better Wellness in 2025
summary: Are TikTok health trends worth your time? Maybe. We picked out 5 daily habits promoted on the popular social media platform that might have real benefits.
body_text: TikTok is a cultural phenomenon that has had a significant impact on many areas of society—including health and wellness culture. Many people are learning about wellness as part of their daily scrolling. While there are definitely positives to getting health and wellness advice through influencer videos, including lifestyle changes that can help with overall health and wellness, it's important to do your own research and carefully discern the difference between credible health advice and viral TikTok health trends that will be gone in a flash. Are you looking for options that can help you get real results? Take a look at these five TikTok wellness trends that can offer real health benefits—and that might just be worth trying. 1. The "50-Jump Ritual" and Other Mindful Morning Routines Increasingly, TikTok influencers have been sharing morning rituals that promote mental health and body positivity. One popular option is the 50 Jump Ritual. You roll out of bed in the morning, and once your feet hit the ground, you jump 50 times. That's it: an accessible morning routine that gets your blood flowing, helps wake you up, and promotes positive movement. The 50 Jump Ritual can: Reduce overall stress. Improve focus. Increase blood flow, raising energy levels first thing. Of course, the 50 Jump Ritual isn't the only solution for mindful mornings. Try habits such as a hydration ritual that encourages you to start drinking your water early in the morning, light stretching, or meditation. Don't forget to include nutrient-rich superfoods in your morning rituals! Functional mushrooms in your morning coffee or starting your day with a protein bar packed full of healthy ingredients are small changes that can make a big difference in your overall energy and wellness. 2. The "Sleepy Girl Mocktail" Before Bed for Better Sleep Ending your evening with a "sleepy girl mocktail" is, according to TikTok influencers, a great way to relax at the end of the day. You can fall asleep, stay asleep, and experience deeper rest—especially when compared to alcoholic cocktails, which can lead to poor or disrupted sleep or cause a host of other potential health issues. What's in a sleepy girl mocktail? It features tart cherry juice and magnesium, which leads to significant sleep benefits due to the tryptophan content and enhanced melatonin production. As a result, users who try this ritual may find they're able to get deeper rest, providing them with more energy throughout the day. Of course, if you want to reap the benefits of the sleepy girl mocktail, it's critical to combine it with good sleep hygiene: a dark room, going to bed around the same time every evening, and avoiding screen time right before bed. These simple strategies can go a long way toward improving the quality of your sleep. If you're interested in further boosting your energy or supporting restful nights, Laird Superfoods has options that may help—from our Sleep and Recover blend that is designed to encourage restful slumber to our Morning Jumpstart for energy that will carry you throughout the morning. 3. Red Light Therapy for Enhanced Skin Health Red light therapy has seen an immense jump in popularity, with many people turning to red light masks to accomplish their skincare goals. Red light therapy may help with collagen production in the skin, leading to anti-aging effects. Red light therapy may also increase energy levels, relieve muscle and joint soreness, and reduce stress. Experts, however, note that to make the most of red light therapy, users should use their devices consistently. It is also recommended that users use protective eyewear and consult a healthcare provider if they suffer from photosensitivity or other health conditions. As you add red light therapy to your routine, consider using antioxidant-rich superfoods to help complement your skincare. Antioxidant-rich foods, including options like our invigorating Daily Reds blend, can help remove toxins from your system and give you the vital glow you've been looking for. 4. Chia Seed Water The viral chia seed water trend on TikTok starts by adding 1-2 tablespoons of chia seeds to a glass of water. Once it's been allowed to sit for a few minutes, soaking the seeds, users can add flavoring, including lemon juice, fruit, or honey. This little hack can offer a number of potential health benefits. Chia seeds contain fiber, omega-3 fatty acids, and antioxidants: a hard-hitting powerhouse that can increase gut health and provide sustained energy throughout the day. While chia seed water can certainly offer potential nutritional benefits, you should carefully consider other areas of your diet, too. Pairing your morning chia seed water with superfood blends, including our Daily Greens blend, can help keep your energy levels high throughout the day. 5. Embracing Mindful Rest (i.e. Is Bed Rotting Good for You?) What is bed rotting? The bed rotting trend is a form of intentional self-care prioritized on TikTok. This trend encourages viewers to fight against "hustle culture" by spending extended time in bed scrolling, watching TV, or otherwise engaging in deliberately restful activities. Bed rotting can offer some benefits—especially if you're struggling with mental health challenges like burnout. When you stay in bed for several extra hours or even for an entire day, it may help you get the mental reset you need to improve your overall mental health and fight those common conditions. In fact, prioritizing rest can offer several vital mental health benefits. Can bed rotting be good for you? Yes, in moderation. However, it's important to balance those periods of rest with physical activity. Even a light walk around the block can be energizing and help protect your body against the risks associated with excessively low activity levels. Experts warn that excessive inactivity can lead to considerable health challenges, including the risk of developing cardiovascular problems. Set healthy boundaries around your bed rotting periods, and make sure that you're using those periods of rest as part of a lifestyle that includes plenty of healthy movement. Alongside your mindful self-care efforts, including time deliberately spent in rest, make sure you're supporting your body with nourishing foods that can help protect both physical and mental health. Eating a healthy diet rich in vitamins and nutrients can help provide you with the energy you need to tackle the items on your To Do list once you roll out of bed again. Evaluate Health Advice Before Diving In TikTok health trends are popular. While some of that information can be valuable, there are also trends out there that can prove potentially damaging to your health and well-being. Always evaluate health advice and do your own research before diving in, and avoid dangerous trends that have the potential to negatively impact you long-term. Consult with medical experts and reliable sources about your next steps on your wellness journey, whether you need advice about the right diet for your needs or suggestions about how to make the most of tools like red light therapy or even bed rotting—and think critically about what benefits they may offer. Are you looking for more solutions that can help you along the way? Explore Laird Superfood for natural, sustainable nutrition that complements your wellness journey.

title: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. Releases Preliminary Estimated Results for Third Quarter and Nine Months Ended September 30, 2025
summary: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. (NASDAQ: MIGI) (“Mawson” or the “Company”), a U.S.-based technology company that designs, builds, and operates next-generation digital infrastructure platforms providing services to the artificial intelligence (AI), high-performance computing (HPC), and digital assets (including Bitcoin mining), and other intensive compute applications market sectors, announced today preliminary, unaudited financial results for the Third Quarter and Nine Months ended September 30, 2025.
body_text: Board of Directors Results Announced MIDLAND, Pa., Oct. 16, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. (NASDAQ: MIGI) (“Mawson” or the “Company”), a U.S.-based technology company that designs, builds, and operates next-generation digital infrastructure platforms providing services to the artificial intelligence (AI), high-performance computing (HPC), and digital assets (including Bitcoin mining), and other intensive compute applications market sectors, announced today preliminary, unaudited financial results for the Third Quarter and Nine Months ended September 30, 2025. Preliminary Estimated Results for the Third Quarter and Nine Months Ended September 30, 2025 Our expectations with respect to our revenue, cost of revenues, gross profit, gross profit margin and net loss for the third quarter and the nine months ended September 30, 2025 discussed below are based upon management estimates for the period. Our expectations are subject to the completion of our financial closing procedures and any adjustments that may result from the completion of the review of our consolidated financial statements for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025. Following the completion of our financial closing process and the review of our consolidated financial statements, we may report revenue, cost of revenues, gross profit, gross profit margin and net loss for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025 that could differ from our expectations, and the differences could be material. The expectations set forth below have been prepared by, and are the responsibility of, our management. Wolf & Company, P.C., our independent registered public accounting firm, has not audited, reviewed, compiled or performed any procedures with respect to the preliminary estimates. Accordingly, Wolf & Company, P.C. does not express an opinion or any other form of assurance with respect thereto. Preliminary Results for Third Quarter Ended September 30, 2025 Preliminary estimated revenues are expected to be approximately $11.2 million for the third quarter of 2025 compared with $12.3 million for the third quarter of 2024, a year-on-year decrease of 9%. Preliminary estimated cost of revenues is expected to be approximately $4.6 million for the third quarter of 2025 compared with $8.0 million for the third quarter of 2024, a year-on-year decrease of 42%. Preliminary estimated gross profit is expected to be approximately $6.6 million for the third quarter of 2025 compared with $4.3 million for the third quarter of 2024, a year-on-year increase of 53%. Preliminary estimated gross profit margin is expected to be 59% for the third quarter of 2025 compared with 35% for the third quarter of 2024. Preliminary net loss is expected to be approximately $1.5 million for the third quarter of 2025 compared with $12.2 million for the third quarter of 2024, a year-on-year decrease of 88%. Preliminary Results for Nine Months Ended September 30, 2025 Preliminary estimated revenues are expected to be approximately $34.5 million for the nine months of 2025 compared with $44.2 million for the nine months of 2024, a year-on-year decrease of 22%. Preliminary estimated cost of revenues is expected to be approximately $18.1 million for the nine months of 2025 compared with $28.6 million for the nine months of 2024, a year-on-year decrease of 37%. Preliminary estimated gross profit is expected to be approximately $16.4 million for the nine months of 2025 compared with $15.6 million for the nine months of 2024, a year-on-year increase of 5%. Preliminary estimated gross profit margin is expected to be 48% for the nine months of 2025 compared with 35% for the nine months of 2024. Preliminary net loss is expected to be approximately $9.8 million for the nine months of 2025 compared with $41.8 million for the nine months of 2024, a year-on-year decrease of 76%. Overall, our reduction in net loss for the nine months ended September 30, 2025 compared to the nine months ended September 30, 2024 is attributable to the following: An increase in gross profit primarily due to a new profit share agreement executed in 2025. A reduction in operating expenses primarily due to a reduction in depreciation and amortization expense and stock based compensation partially offset by an increase in selling, general and administrative costs. A reduction in non-operating expenses primarily due to 2024 including a loss on deconsolidation of $12.4 million. Results of the Annual Shareholder Meeting At the Company’s 2025 Annual Meeting of Shareholders (the “2025 Annual Meeting”), the following nominees for director were elected to serve until the Company’s 2026 Annual Meeting: Ryan Costello - Independent Board Chair, Chair of Nominating & Governance Committee Former U.S. Congressman (PA) and long-time public policy / strategic communications advisor; founded Ryan Costello Strategies, LLC and brings public policy, regulatory and governance experience. Mr. Costello earned a J.D. from Villanova and undergraduate degree from Ursinus College and has an executive education certificate from Wharton (Economics of Blockchain & Digital Assets). Steven G. Soles - Independent Director, Chair of the Audit Committee and Chair of Strategic Transactions Committee COO & General Counsel of Elmagin Capital LLC (quant investment firm focused on U.S. wholesale electricity markets) since 2014; prior VP & General Counsel at TFS Capital. Holds a B.A. (West Chester University) and J.D. (Villanova). Mr. Soles brings legal, M&A, compliance and transactional experience to the board. Kathryn (Katie) Yingling Schellenger - Independent Director, Chair of Compensation Committee Kathryn (Katie) Yingling Schellenger joins the board as an independent director after being elected at the 2025 Annual Meeting. Since 2022, Ms. Schellenger has served as Head of Global Compliance / Senior Counsel at a global luxury retail brand. Previously, Ms. Schellenger served as Director, Ethics & Compliance at Qurate Retail Group. She is a Cum Laude graduate of both Bucknell University and Villanova University School of Law. Ms. Schellenger brings with her deep experience in building global ethics and compliance programs for retail companies, leading whistleblower and internal investigations programs, and reporting to boards on compliance matters. About Mawson Infrastructure Mawson is a U.S.-based technology company that designs, builds, and operates next-generation digital infrastructure platforms. The company provides services spanning AI, HPC, digital assets (including Bitcoin mining), and other intensive compute applications. Mawson delivers both self-mining operations and colocation/hosting for enterprise customers, with a vertically integrated infrastructure model built for scalability and efficiency. A core part of Mawson’s strategy is powering its operations with carbon-free energy resources—including nuclear power—ensuring that its compute platforms support the rapid growth of the digital economy in an environmentally sustainable way. With 129 megawatts of capacity already online and more under development, Mawson is positioning itself as a competitive provider of carbon-aware digital infrastructure solutions. title: Unveiling the AI Platform for Transit Planning
body_text: NEW YORK, NY October 14, 2025 – Meet Ontra Mobility's AI platform for transit planning: forecast demand, optimize fixed routes, integrate on-demand zones, and simulate what-ifs to balance cost, ridership, and convenience. Plan in weeks, not years. Ontra's AI Planning Platform brings together demand forecasting, fixed-route optimization, and on-demand zone integration to design coherent networks that serve more riders with fewer resources. Agencies can rapidly test stop spacing, headways, route variants, and zone boundaries to understand the real tradeoffs between access, cost, and reliability. Planners can compare scenarios side-by-side with clear metrics on access improvements, travel time changes, on-time performance, and operating cost impacts. Purpose-built workflows streamline stakeholder review and board-ready materials so teams can move from concept to decision in weeks, not years. The platform integrates GTFS alongside agency operational and demographic datasets, ensuring analyses reflect real-world conditions. Results can be shared via interactive reports and exported for procurement, grant applications, and implementation. About Ontra Mobility Ontra Mobility revolutionizes urban transit by providing a platform for cities and agencies to plan, integrate, and operate efficient, accessible, and sustainable bus, shuttle, and paratransit services. Their data-driven approach, developed by former Google engineers, optimizes routes and real-time dispatching to enhance ridership and reduce costs.
